newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Sunwear stake lifted by group.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Sunwear stake lifted by group.

text.p: A group including Zweig-DiMenna Parters LP said Tuesday it raised its stake in Pacific Sunwear of California Inc to 730,900 common shares or nine percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 100,000 shares between February 11 and February 21 at prices ranging from $25.2250 to $27.3688 per share.
Pacific Sunwear is an Anaheim, Calif.,-based speciality retailer of casual apparel, accessories and footwear for teenagers and young adults.
